approval.decisions: OQ-22 and OQ-23; release-2 classifications approved

description: Proposed re-expression of the 89 seed exercises in the new model (release 2). Ids unchanged. All mechanics, laterality, difficulty, attribute, role and alias values here are the release-2 classifications approved by the owner on 2026-11-05, assigned under the editorial guide. Disputed primary assignments are resolved in the tranche content reviews under the primary-muscle principle. flags: M meaning of a tag changes; D debatable tag kept; E equipment tag inaccurate (proposedEquipment fixes it); R refinement to a finer node (applied in the proposed list); S secondary list changed; N note. mechanics null means empty for cardio and mobility (approved 2026-11-05). cleanup lists release-2 clean-up items (alias collisions and doubtful secondaries).

seedProvenance.note: Applies to all 89 seed exercises in release 2 (IC-212). Approved. AI drafting assistance is permitted and recorded in provenance; a named human editor is the accountable author.
